cultural_caution: Do not treat Annwvyn as a generic hell, faerie plane, or game dimension.

work_or_witness: The Mabinogion · Content of the White Book of Rhydderch, lines 173–180
definition: The name associated especially with the Four Branches, not a source-native generic label for every character or all Welsh myth.
cultural_caution: The plural collection title “Mabinogion” and the term's interpretation are historically and editorially contested.

supports: Manuscript context for the Four Branches and related tales.
